scope: Read-only report, fixture, persisted-run and PDF-byte audit. Page-limit recovery is offline revalidation, not process-crash recovery or an extra HTTP acquisition.
source_count_note: Catalogue entries are counted separately; shared PDF hashes do not become distinct documents or prove independent source families.
tests_note: Per-report counts overlap; do not sum these suites as unique tests.
remaining_gate_requirements: Continuous replay for all new valid and blocked sources with deduplication and failure isolation.
Real process-crash recovery for the new valid source scope.
Mixed queue capacity proof covering the new batch and retry behavior.
Canonical creation/update review evidence from preserved new-batch PDFs with documentary holds.
Resolve missing contracts and external/documentary impediments or explicitly adjudicate their bounded exclusion before gate acceptance.
